climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Seasons this cool ripen Müller-Thurgau, Pinot Gris, Gewürztraminer and Riesling fully without cooking off their freshness.

soil.rock: Sand is warm and airy. It drains fast but holds little water, and phylloxera does not thrive in it.
soil.top: The topsoil drains fast and warms early in spring. Vines get little water, which keeps crops small and flavors concentrated, but drought bites hard. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: Mostly flat. Easy and cheap to farm by machine, but on still nights cold air settles on flat ground, so spring frost is a bigger risk.
